name: clutch-agency-api
title: Clutch.co Agency API: B2B Company Data, Directory & Reviews
description: Company data API for Clutch.co, the B2B directory of agencies and service providers. Build a marketing agency database with ratings, pricing, service mix, team size, locations and every verified client review, returned as JSON plus LLM-ready markdown. Pay per row, MCP-ready for Claude and AI agents.

events.name: listing-scraped
events.title: Company listing scraped
events.description: Fee per company row returned from a directory or category page. Charged once for each listing pushed to the dataset.

events.name: profile-scraped
events.title: Company profile scraped
events.description: Fee per full company profile returned, including ratings, pricing, service mix, focus areas, industries and locations. Charged once for each profile pushed to the dataset.

events.name: review-scraped
events.title: Client review scraped
events.description: Fee per client review returned. Charged once for each review pushed to the dataset. Only charged when reviews are enabled.

events.name: business-email-verified
events.title: Business contact email verified
events.description: Optional Module B add-on. Charged when a published company-website contact email is verified and delivered. Requires enrichBusinessEmail.

events.name: business-email-lookup
events.title: Business email attempt fee
events.description: Optional Module B attempt fee when crawl/verify ran and no verified email was delivered. Never stacks on a find. Requires enrichBusinessEmail.

events.name: apify-default-dataset-item
events.title: Dataset item stored
events.description: Platform accounting charge, applied per row stored in the dataset.
